annotations.title: Look up a site in the registry

description: Free. The last dated verdict for a website, if it was ever checked and listed: verdict, score, date and badge. An unknown site is a normal answer (known: false), not an error. To get a fresh check, buy one (see get_pricing).

url.description: The https URL (or hostname) of the site, e.g. https://example.com/.
